description: This PHP source file defines the SystemConfiguration class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages configuration data related to the system such as organization info, admin details, and instance identification, and interacts with a database via Doctrine DBAL. The class includes methods for retrieving configuration details, setting up an instance identifier, and handling registration events.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: A class managing system configuration, including organization details, admin info, and registration events, interacting with the database and configuration helpers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SystemConfiguration object, setting up the ConfigHelper.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Gets the schema manager for database schema operations.

methods.name: getOrganizationName
methods.description: Fetches the organization name from the database or returns default if not set.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Fetches the country information from the database or returns default if not set.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the default language setting from the configuration, defaults to en_US.

methods.name: getAdminFirstName
methods.description: Retrieves the admin user's first name from the database, defaults to 'Admin'.

methods.name: getAdminLastName
methods.description: Retrieves the admin user's last name.

methods.name: getAdminContactNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the admin user's contact number.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Gets the current instance identifier from configuration.

methods.name: getAdminEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Private method that fetches the admin employee number from the database, caching the result.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Sets a new instance identifier based on provided system information.

methods.name: createInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded identifier string from system details.

methods.name: isRegistrationEventQueueAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the registration event queue table exists in the schema.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Inserts a registration event record into the database, with optional data and timestamps.
